# CommanderBG

> CommanderBG (https://commanderbg.com) is a free daily strategy puzzle game in the browser.

## How it works
- A new map every day at midnight Mountain Time; everyone gets the same map.
- Difficulty follows the week: Monday easiest, Friday and Saturday hardest, Sunday medium.
- Your Commander holds the 3×3 around it. You place Archers (take 3 squares left and right; fly over walls and water; trees stop them), Soldiers (take 2 squares up and down; walk through trees and wade water; walls stop them) and, on some days, Scouts (take 2 squares along each diagonal).
- Troops can only stand on ground you already hold, so the order you place them is the puzzle.
- Practice freely; one Attack counts. After attacking you see your stars, your rank among players, the score distribution, and the best possible layout.
- Free, no download, no account needed to play. An email lets you keep your score, earn rank and streaks.

## Links
- Play today's puzzle: https://commanderbg.com/
- 2-minute tutorial: https://commanderbg.com/commander/tutorial
